page.layout: Two-column arithmetic page. Top: a fragment of a previous worked calculation, centred, and a centred italic title "Aliud exemplum." Below: running text in one column with a worked calculation set out beneath it in several parallel columns (left, middle, right), the right edge cut off by the scan. "Iam" at the lower right is the catchword.

main_text.p: Duo mercatores societate inita lucrati sunt 146 ½. Alter autē contulit 136 ¼ : Alter vero 198 ⅓. Quæstio est quantum cuiq; cedat?
Primùm priori summæ subjicio alteram, & integros numeros per additionem colligo: Deinde fractiones: Tertiò secundùm Regulam Detri progredior.

page.notes: The calculation is set out in parallel columns and is not fully legible at the right edge; cell alignment is approximate. The fraction "4/7" at the upper right and the "¼ X ⅓" in the middle are doubtful in placement. Faint marks at the foot of the page (possibly show-through) are left out. The top fragment "195 — 288 — 40 / 75 / 80" is the end of a previous example and is kept as printed. The catchword "Iam" is read at the lower right.
